summary.honest_verdict: Publishing ROI is indirect and manual. Lead and ad ROI is unmeasurable until APIs connect.

roi_map.name: Low-Risk Publishing
roi_map.how: Postiz publishes → IG analytics (via mcporter) shows reach/likes/engagement → GA4 tracks website sessions via UTM → booking confirmations from Swing Shack website
roi_map.gap: Cannot automatically link IG post → specific booking. Needs: Postiz booking attribution API or UTM pass-through to booking system.

roi_map.name: GMB Posts
roi_map.how: Weekly GMB posts via Postiz → Google Business Profile shows post views → profile visits → direction calls
roi_map.gap: No live GMB insights API. Post views and profile visits are visible in GMB dashboard manually.

roi_map.name: Review Thank-Yous
roi_map.how: 5-star thank-yous posted to Google → review rating trend → review count trend
current_data: manual review of Google Business Profile
roi_map.gap: No live Google Reviews API. Review response is manual. Only reviews visible publicly.

roi_map.name: Lead Routing
roi_map.gap: WhatsApp Business API not connected. lead_router_live is 100% simulated. No real leads routed.

roi_map.name: Budget Shifts
roi_map.gap: Meta Ads API not connected. Budget shifts are placeholder. Cannot measure ROAS.

roi_map.name: Evergreen Reposts
roi_map.how: Same as low_risk_publish — IG analytics shows engagement on reposted content
roi_map.gap: Cannot distinguish evergreen repost from new post without Postiz post-level analytics.

roi_map.name: Fallback Swaps
roi_map.how: A/B winner confirmed → winner hook used in next posts → IG analytics shows if winner continues to outperform
roi_map.gap: Fallback swaps are infrequent. Cannot isolate swap effect from content quality.

roi_map.name: Auto-Promote Approved
roi_map.how: Time from approval to publish tracked in Postiz → faster publishing = more content consistency
roi_map.gap: No automated approval-to-publish time tracking. Manual correlation needed.
